title: Text: DET Nick Castellanos ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: so I landed in TEX yesterday to a text saying 1A (front pg) wanted my story for today’s paper and I thought  it was coming out on Sunday so I had to scramble. So sorry I couldn’t get it to you but my email keeps blowing up with people who like it so I think it’s good.
Thanks for taking the time. Do work out there, have fun
